acceptanceCriteria: Every target SPDX document contains exactly one standard release-archive Package and one release-binary File whose names and nonzero SHA-256 digests match the actual staged archive and executable, with DOCUMENT DESCRIBES and Package CONTAINS relationships.
SBOM binding fails closed for a wrong target, filename, digest, zero digest, missing or duplicate release Package or File, or missing or duplicate binding relationship.

The staged candidate and public release asset inventory is exact and deterministic: five archives, five target SBOMs, release-manifest.json, ai-cockpit.rb, and SHA256SUMS, with no orphan ai-cockpit-build.spdx.json, duplicate, or unbound publishable asset.
SHA256SUMS covers every intended public asset other than itself exactly once in stable filename order, and staged validation rejects missing, duplicate, extra, or digest-mismatched entries.
The final SLSA attestation subject set matches the exact public asset set and existing staged/public adopter acceptance and hosted attestation gates remain fail-closed.

Static policy tests and English, Simplified Chinese, and Japanese release documentation explain artifact binding, closed asset inventory, checksum coverage, and that v0.2.31 published truth is not rewritten.
Focused Rust, release policy, documentation, formatting, lint, and full workspace checks pass with current Runtime verification evidence.
goal: Fail closed before publication when a target SBOM is orphaned, duplicated, unbound, or digest-mismatched, or when the release manifest and SHA256SUMS do not exactly cover the intended public assets.
intent: Make newly built release SBOMs verifiably describe the exact packaged archive and executable, and make the published asset inventory closed and checksum-complete without rewriting the already published v0.2.31 release truth.
outOfScope: Published v0.2.31 tag and GitHub Release assets
Historical v0.2.31 attestations and acceptance receipts
Version bump or publication of a new release
Adopter acceptance and upgrade harness behavior
Provider release settings rulesets or evidence retention

scenarioCoverage.expected: Each target SBOM binds exactly one packaged archive and its executable by their actual nonzero SHA-256 digests and standard SPDX relationships.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Run the cockpit-release SBOM regressions against tar.gz and zip packages, then validate the generated SPDX documents against the staged bytes.

scenarioCoverage.expected: Missing, duplicated, wrong-target, wrong-name, zero, and digest-mismatched SBOM bindings fail closed.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Run negative cockpit-release fixtures that mutate each binding field and relationship independently.

scenarioCoverage.expected: The candidate inventory rejects orphan or duplicate publishable assets and SHA256SUMS covers every intended public asset except itself exactly once in stable order.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Run manifest regressions for orphan ai-cockpit-build.spdx.json, duplicate names, missing checksum entries, extra checksum entries, digest mismatches, and deterministic ordering.

scenarioCoverage.expected: The release workflow creates only target-bound SBOMs and keeps attestation plus staged and public adopter-acceptance gates fail closed.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Run the static release workflow policy and documentation acceptance checks, then inspect hosted pull-request checks without publishing a release.
